newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 23.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 23.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Water levels are decreasing throughout Europe.
- The Hungarian consulate in the Romanian town of Cluj was ofiicially opened.
- There are 27 Hungarian names on the Swiss Banking Union's dormand accounts list.
- The Agriculture Ministry reaffirmed it expects a five million tonnes wheat crop.
- The social security will only pay dentistry bills of those who take part in a dentistry screening this year.
- The parliamentary group of opposition party KDNP will officially dissolve itself on Thursday.
